answer_1.quote: Text style transfer aims at rephrasing an input sentence as an output sentence in a target style (e.g. sentiment change from negative to positive), while preserving the original content.
answer_1.outputs: The lounge is very outdated -> The food is delicious

answer_2.quote: We use the same automatic evaluation metrics from prior studies to evaluate the outputs in terms of semantic preservation, style transfer strength and fluency.

answer_4.quote: Two raters with native-like English proficiency selected the best sentence(s) among all candidates for the dimensions of content preservation, transfer strength and fluency separately.
